svg.title: KS-09 animated top view
svg.desc: Synthetic (DSR-12), no evidence credit. Looping top view of KS-09 (Cut-out revealing a stopped vehicle) from its esmini replay at the parameter defaults, 16.9 to 24.6 s: The lead changes lane and reveals a stopped car. Plot: gap to the stopped car (m). Events: lead starts its lane change, 45 m short of the stopped car at 19.9 s; lead leaves the ego lane: the stopped car is in the open at 20.9 s; loop ends before contact at 24.6 s. Layer 2 fixes the road and the other road users. The ego only holds its start speed here; the item under test drives it in layer 1 and on the bench, so the loop ends before the bodies overlap. Cars: Kenney Racing Pack (CC0).
